description: This file defines the InstallerCompleteController class, which is part of the installer flow for OrangeHRM. It handles pre-rendering logic to display the completion screen, sets up the Vue component with product version information, updates installation state, and logs the installation status.

classes.name: InstallerCompleteController
classes.description: Controller responsible for setting up and rendering the installer completion view, including setting the product version property and updating installation state.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the component for rendering by setting up the Vue component with product version info, updates the installation state, and logs the current installation status.
